ios.desc:
Preview EPUB, MOBI and comic book files with Quick Look on Mac, iPhone and iPad. One purchase includes Book Preview for all three.

Book Preview is an ebook and comic file viewer for your own files. Use EPUB Quick Look in Finder on Mac or preview supported books in the Files app on iPhone and iPad—without importing them into a library.

EPUB QUICK LOOK AND EBOOK PREVIEWS

• Preview EPUB and KEPUB books, including text, covers and embedded images
• Open MOBI and other supported Mobipocket files
• View FB2 books and browse DJVU pages
• See book metadata where available
• Inspect OPF and NCX files

COMIC BOOK PREVIEWS

Browse the images inside CBZ, CBR, CB7, CBT and CBA comic archives. Use Quick Look for a fast preview or open a supported file in Book Preview.

HOW TO PREVIEW A BOOK

On Mac, select a supported file in Finder and press the spacebar. On iPhone or iPad, preview it in Files or open it in Book Preview.

Book Preview works with your own files and doesn’t include books or comics. DRM-protected books are not supported. Preview results can vary by file.
